args.title: Fix aria-live region for error messages in toast notifications
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Modify the aria-live region for error messages to announce them immediately and ensure they remain visible until dismissed, differing from success messages.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error messages shown as toasts use the same polite aria-live region as success messages, causing screen readers to wait before announcing them. Errors should be announced at once and should stay until they are dismissed.
